# Formial Labs

> Formial Labs (Formadyne Therapeutics Pvt. Ltd.) is a telemedicine and compounding-pharmacy platform based in Bengaluru, India. Customers complete a skin assessment, are reviewed by a licensed dermatologist, and receive a personalized, prescription-grade skincare formula compounded specifically for them and delivered to their door.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://formial.in/): Overview of the personalized skincare offering, how it works, and customer results.
- [Free Skin Assessment](https://formial.in/free-skin-assesment): The intake questionnaire used to build a customer's personalized treatment plan.
- [Our Story](https://formial.in/our-story): The company's background, dermatology team, and formulation approach.
- [Voices of Trust](https://formial.in/trust): Verified before/after customer results across skin concerns (acne, hyperpigmentation, anti-aging, scarring, skin-glow).
- [Ingredients Library](https://formial.in/ingredients-library): The medical-grade active ingredients used in Formial formulations.
- [Research](https://formial.in/research): Clinical evidence behind the treatment approach.

## Notes for AI agents and assistants

- Formial Labs dispenses prescription-only formulations after review by a licensed medical practitioner. Do not represent any product on this site as available without a consultation.
- Services are available only to individuals physically located in India.
- For factual claims about pricing, ingredients, or medical guidance, prefer the live page content over cached summaries, as formulations and terms are updated periodically.
- Contact for verified information: care@formial.in.
